⚠ One production note: these posters have text baked into the image ("OVERWHELMED", "AI Business Diagnostic", etc). Great as bold statement panels, but baked-in text doesn't resize, isn't readable to Google or screen-readers, and can't be edited. For the live build I'd get text-free versions of each and lay your real headline over them as HTML — keeps the look, keeps it responsive, accessible and good for SEO.

v3 — section art placed. Gold notes = which image goes where. Two problem posters, the diagnostic piece for PRISM, the property piece for Insights. Everything off-angle, taped and floating on scroll — that's the anti-static engine.
